## APIs and tools for building AI products. The most powerful platform for building AI products. Build and scale AI experiences powered by industry-leading models and tools. This is the 52nd launch from OpenAI. ## GPT-6 Sol and and Luna. Near-Astra intelligence for a fifth of the price. GPT-6 Sol and Luna are fast, cost-efficient AI models for professional work, coding, computer use, and long-running agents. Built with advances from GPT-6 Astra, they deliver stronger factual accuracy and clearer collaboration while API prices are 50% lower than GPT-5.6. Choose Sol for demanding tasks and Luna for high-volume, everyday AI workloads. GPT-6 Sol & LunaFrontier AI intelligence, now at half the price. OpenAI Agents APICloud agents, run on OpenAI's Codex harness. GPT-6 AstraOpenAI's most capable model for end-to-end work. Reviewers largely see OpenAI as strong, practical, and easy to build with: they praise fast, reliable APIs, solid documentation, and models that handle coding, writing, reasoning, image work, and structured outputs well enough for daily workflows. Compared to alternatives, OpenAI feels less like a single model and more like a long-term platform we can confidently build on.
